P-1bdb741b32f35da8.en: Does the company report on the scope or boundaries of its sustainability disclosure?
P-1bdb741b32f35da8.zh: 公司是否报告其可持续发展披露的范围或边界？

P-e58b0443f67458d3.en: Does the company have external assurance for its sustainability reporting?
P-e58b0443f67458d3.zh: 公司的可持续发展报告是否经过外部鉴证？

P-e1e1659a9066fafe.en: Does the company publicly report on breaches of the code of conduct for the last financial year?
P-e1e1659a9066fafe.zh: 公司是否公开报告上一财年违反行为准则的情况？

P-2d28bf45d6449207.en: Does the company report on key business, financial and tax information for each tax jurisdiction in which it operates?
P-2d28bf45d6449207.zh: 公司是否报告其开展业务的各税收管辖区的关键业务、财务和税务信息？

P-6fe05b1bf072345b.en: Does the company have an independence statement for the board of directors?
P-6fe05b1bf072345b.zh: 公司是否有董事会独立性声明？

P-f198a021cd1f5b28.en: Does the company disclose details of its materiality determination process and how the materiality analysis is conducted?
P-f198a021cd1f5b28.zh: 公司是否披露其重要性判定流程的详情，以及重要性分析的开展方式？

P-24f74fc2e60f47f5.en: Does the company have targets or metrics linked to the top three material issues and does it disclose the progress of these targets or metrics? Does the company link executive compensation with the targets or metrics involved?
P-24f74fc2e60f47f5.zh: 公司是否针对前三项重大议题设定了相关目标或指标，并披露这些目标或指标的进展？公司是否将高管薪酬与相关目标或指标挂钩？

P-6b3768893268e8a7.en: Has the company evaluated the positive/negative impacts on external stakeholders using quantitative output and impact metrics?
P-6b3768893268e8a7.zh: 公司是否使用量化产出和影响指标评估对外部利益相关方的正面/负面影响？

P-d56077b7436cf4e5.en: Does the company have governance mechanisms in place to oversee climate-related issues?
P-d56077b7436cf4e5.zh: 公司是否建立了监督气候相关议题的治理机制？

P-cda973dd25b85001.en: Does the company have a climate risk management process?
P-cda973dd25b85001.zh: 公司是否设有气候风险管理流程？

P-e96f52e85b74799a.en: Does the company have corporate-level emissions reduction targets?
P-e96f52e85b74799a.zh: 公司是否设定了公司层面的减排目标？

P-f893aa9bce3ca5bd.en: Does the company track its indirect greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 3)?
P-f893aa9bce3ca5bd.zh: 公司是否追踪其间接温室气体排放（范围3）？

P-b090f3f37fed7966.en: Does the company monitor the following indicators regarding workforce gender diversity?
P-b090f3f37fed7966.zh: 公司是否监测以下有关员工性别多元化的指标？

P-c6ae058bd1c5511e.en: Does the company report on its board type?
P-c6ae058bd1c5511e.zh: 公司是否报告其董事会类型？

P-998dd838028aed06.en: Does the company have governance mechanisms in place to oversee ESG/sustainability issues?
P-998dd838028aed06.zh: 公司是否建立了监督ESG/可持续发展议题的治理机制？

P-85e4d4685db6223f.en: Does the company have a group-wide policy on anti-bribery and anti-corruption and is it available publicly?
P-85e4d4685db6223f.zh: 公司是否制定全集团反贿赂与反腐败政策，并可公开查阅？

P-fa60b6aedfb69792.en: Does the company track its freshwater consumption, including water withdrawal and discharge?
P-fa60b6aedfb69792.zh: 公司是否追踪其淡水消耗，包括取水和排水？

P-3ec99cf62f6eface.en: Does the company track its indirect greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 2)?
P-3ec99cf62f6eface.zh: 公司是否追踪其间接温室气体排放（范围2）？

P-67e288b83ee6540e.en: Does the company have a group-wide commitment to respect human rights and is it available publicly?
P-67e288b83ee6540e.zh: 公司是否制定全集团尊重人权承诺，并可公开查阅？

P-f198bdcd17420420.en: Does the company report whether it has conducted an assessment of potential human rights issues across its business activities in the last three years?
P-f198bdcd17420420.zh: 公司是否报告其在过去三年内是否对其业务活动中的潜在人权问题开展过评估？

P-09416010193382e2.en: Does the company have a policy outlining its approach to sustainable investment and is it available publicly?
P-09416010193382e2.zh: 公司是否有一项说明其可持续投资方法的政策，并且该政策是否公开可获取？

P-bb2e780dee9a3240.en: Is the board of directors/supervisory board headed by a non-executive and independent chairperson and/or an independent lead director?
P-bb2e780dee9a3240.zh: 董事会/监事会是否由非执行且独立的主席领导，和/或是否任命了独立首席董事？

P-6cd15989ce243b23.en: Does the company report on the number and names of the board members with relevant work experience in its sector according to GICS Level 1 sector classification (excluding executive members and employee representatives)?
P-6cd15989ce243b23.zh: 公司是否报告其所在行业中具有相关工作经验的董事会成员人数和姓名，行业按 GICS Level 1 行业分类确定（不包括执行成员和职工代表）？

P-0a87487e26d8d8a0.en: Does the company report whether governmental institutions own more than 5% of the total voting rights of the company?
P-0a87487e26d8d8a0.zh: 公司是否报告政府机构所持投票权是否超过公司总投票权的5%？

P-4e13b35fd4c09bf3.en: Does the company have governance mechanisms to oversee its information security activities?
P-4e13b35fd4c09bf3.zh: 公司是否建立了监督信息安全活动的治理机制？

P-8b22f18acda7165c.en: Does the company have programs to manage its labor practices?
P-8b22f18acda7165c.zh: 公司是否有管理其劳动实践的计划？

P-2b7f426a72b1c5b4.en: Does the company have programs to mitigate and remediate negative impacts of human rights risks?
P-2b7f426a72b1c5b4.zh: 公司是否有计划来缓解和补救人权风险造成的负面影响？

P-38276a992e40d7ac.en: Does the company conduct individual and/or team-based performance appraisals?
P-38276a992e40d7ac.zh: 公司是否开展个人和/或团队绩效评估？

P-0a2ddb6aa3a46e6f.en: Does the company have a policy on responsible artificial intelligence and is it available publicly?
P-0a2ddb6aa3a46e6f.zh: 公司是否制定负责任人工智能政策，并可公开查阅？

P-865e94a6014199b1.en: Does the company have governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks?
P-865e94a6014199b1.zh: 公司是否建立了监督风险的治理机制？

P-0f86400d57ec3f04.en: Does the company have risk management processes to promote effective risk culture?
P-0f86400d57ec3f04.zh: 公司是否设有风险管理流程，以促进形成有效的风险文化？

P-fc9d82ba965c1039.en: Does the company conduct climate-related scenario analysis?
P-fc9d82ba965c1039.zh: 公司是否开展气候相关情景分析？

P-e4fc1395d50cde0a.en: Does the company have a company-wide human rights due diligence process?
P-e4fc1395d50cde0a.zh: 公司是否设有全公司范围的人权尽职调查流程？

P-c5607203a3babf8b.en: Is the company a participant of the UN Global Compact?
P-c5607203a3babf8b.zh: 公司是否为联合国全球契约的参与方？

P-42842ac3fc14ef20.en: Does the company report any contributions to or expenditures to political campaigns or organizations, lobbying, trade associations, tax-exempt entities, or other groups whose role is to influence political campaigns or public policy and legislation?
P-42842ac3fc14ef20.zh: 公司是否报告向政治竞选活动或组织、游说、行业协会、免税实体或其他旨在影响政治竞选活动、公共政策和立法的团体提供的任何捐款或支出？

P-fdad5c518d0dc793.en: Has the company committed to reaching net-zero emissions across its value chain and is it available publicly?
P-fdad5c518d0dc793.zh: 公司是否承诺在整个价值链实现净零排放，并且相关信息是否可公开获取？

P-199068748458c705.en: Does the company integrate the TCFD framework in the management of climate-related risks and opportunities?
P-199068748458c705.zh: 公司是否在管理气候相关风险和机遇时纳入 TCFD 框架？

P-9a01347d948549bc.en: Does the company have measures to ensure effective implementation of its suppliers' ESG programs?
P-9a01347d948549bc.zh: 公司是否采取措施，确保其供应商的ESG计划得到有效实施？

P-b3584b7bd997ba99.en: Does the company have programs on waste management?
P-b3584b7bd997ba99.zh: 公司是否有废弃物管理计划？

P-a67844701f46ed46.en: Does the company have a supplier code of conduct and is it available publicly?
P-a67844701f46ed46.zh: 公司是否有供应商行为准则，并且该准则是否公开可获取？

P-3ddcc6e905b5fe07.en: Does the company have a commitment on biodiversity and is it available publicly?
P-3ddcc6e905b5fe07.zh: 公司是否制定生物多样性承诺，并可公开查阅？

P-33f68a10dde6edea.en: Does the company track the ratio of the median or mean employee compensation or the total annual compensation of the CEO?
P-33f68a10dde6edea.zh: 公司是否跟踪员工薪酬中位数或平均值与 CEO 年度总薪酬之间的比率？

P-21a586d9d2b57685.en: Does the company monitor and set quantitative targets to improve satisfaction and are targets and results communicated externally?
P-21a586d9d2b57685.zh: 公司是否监测并设定提高满意度的量化目标，并对外沟通目标和结果？

P-e2d3b263e93ee4bf.en: Does the company publicly report on the lost-time injury frequency rate (LTIFR) for its employees?
P-e2d3b263e93ee4bf.zh: 公司是否公开报告其员工的损失工时伤害频率（LTIFR）？

P-19089e80301f52d1.en: Does the company publicly report on paid significant fines or penalties related to the environment or ecology for the last four years?
P-19089e80301f52d1.zh: 公司是否公开报告过去四年中已支付的重大环境或生态相关罚款或处罚？

P-65d66ecc4c55f0c6.en: Does the company have specific stock ownership requirements for the CEO and other members of its executive committee?
P-65d66ecc4c55f0c6.zh: 公司是否对首席执行官（CEO）及其执行委员会其他成员设有具体的持股要求？

P-d220fa38c1aad004.en: Does the company track its employee turnover rate?
P-d220fa38c1aad004.zh: 公司是否追踪员工流动率？

P-e28054001263ace1.en: Does the company have measures in place to ensure effective implementation of its privacy policy?
P-e28054001263ace1.zh: 公司是否采取措施，确保其隐私政策得到有效实施？

P-18c325f7d5607fa0.en: Does the company have a program in place to manage and improve customer relations?
P-18c325f7d5607fa0.zh: 公司是否建立了管理并改善客户关系的计划？

P-78faa5fa141187cd.en: Does the company assess the sites used for its operational activities in order to identify sites with significant biodiversity impacts?
P-78faa5fa141187cd.zh: 公司是否评估其运营活动所涉及的场址，以识别对生物多样性有重大影响的场址？

P-3d63dd9946a46826.en: Does the company track its total hazardous waste recycled/reused and disposed?
P-3d63dd9946a46826.zh: 公司是否追踪其危险废弃物回收利用/再使用和处置总量？

P-3629a458b7b01592.en: Does the company report the tax rate (income statement) and cash tax rate (cash flow statement) for the last two financial years?
P-3629a458b7b01592.zh: 公司是否报告最近两个财年的税率（损益表）和现金税率（现金流量表）？

P-3c0a5ba013415554.en: Does the company have a commitment to reduce or phase out hazardous substances in its products or substances, or general product portfolio and is it available publicly?
P-3c0a5ba013415554.zh: 公司是否承诺减少或逐步淘汰其产品或物质中的危险物质，或在整体产品组合中减少或逐步淘汰危险物质，并可公开查阅？

P-87b57565fef6a1ba.en: Does the company have a group-wide policy on stakeholder engagement and is it available publicly?
P-87b57565fef6a1ba.zh: 公司是否制定全集团利益相关方参与政策，并可公开查阅？

P-85f6cc187eb96da3.en: Does the company have programs on water risk management?
P-85f6cc187eb96da3.zh: 公司是否有水风险管理计划？

P-8b408df8276b3d01.en: Does the company track its revenues from sustainable products or services?
P-8b408df8276b3d01.zh: 公司是否追踪其可持续产品或服务收入？

P-0ed2b47dcb789933.en: Does the company track its revenues derived from products containing minerals from conflict-affected and high-risk areas?
P-0ed2b47dcb789933.zh: 公司是否追踪来自含有冲突影响地区和高风险地区矿物的产品的收入？

P-b6343941c6ad234d.en: Does the company track the amounts of plastic packaging used?
P-b6343941c6ad234d.zh: 公司是否追踪所用塑料包装的数量？

P-7668c229591196ec.en: Does the company track its revenues derived from eco-labeled products?
P-7668c229591196ec.zh: 公司是否追踪其生态标签产品产生的收入？

P-972a5c7f5d071dbc.en: Does the company track its total food loss & waste?
P-972a5c7f5d071dbc.zh: 公司是否追踪其食物损失和食物浪费总量？

P-893a971030e82512.en: Does the company actively and directly engage in product take-back programs (e.g., disassembly, re-manufacturing, reuse or recycling of the product and its components)?
P-893a971030e82512.zh: 公司是否积极、直接参与产品回收计划（例如拆解、再制造、再使用或回收产品及其部件）？

P-d1a24d742e9c07aa.en: Does the company have a company-wide framework on community consultation?
P-d1a24d742e9c07aa.zh: 公司是否制定全公司范围的社区协商框架？

P-ba70cd9ad60f4ecb.en: Does the company have programs on engaging with indigenous peoples?
P-ba70cd9ad60f4ecb.zh: 公司是否有与原住民开展互动的计划？

P-35673625adcf6153.en: Does the company systematically track and map the exposure of its suppliers to water-related risks with a comprehensive water tool taking into account local physical water risks?
P-35673625adcf6153.zh: 公司是否使用综合水资源工具，考虑当地实体水风险，系统追踪并绘制其供应商面临的水相关风险敞口？

P-a719b7b9ac13ed78.en: Does the company have strategies to control and reduce the amount of construction and demolition waste from buildings that they construct or that are part of its portfolio?
P-a719b7b9ac13ed78.zh: 公司是否制定了控制和减少其建造的建筑物或其资产组合中建筑物产生的建筑和拆除废弃物数量的策略？

P-3435018a3cc81af6.en: Does the company have programs on managing its owned or operated tailings storage facilities (TSFs)?
P-3435018a3cc81af6.zh: 公司是否有计划管理其自有或运营的尾矿储存设施（TSF）？

P-c7822346e12ca8f6.en: Does the company have programs to ensure local communities have other forms of resources and capital once a mine is closed?
P-c7822346e12ca8f6.zh: 公司是否有计划确保矿山关闭后当地社区拥有其他形式的资源和资本？

P-1966c8e515c0b082.en: Does the company track its ethical marketing and labelling performance?
P-1966c8e515c0b082.zh: 公司是否追踪其道德营销和标签表现？

P-18563cdb8d8fddc7.en: Does the company have a commitment on sustainable agriculture and is it available publicly?
P-18563cdb8d8fddc7.zh: 公司是否制定可持续农业承诺，并可公开查阅？

P-03e22f1810e56fd1.en: Does the company track its sustainable revenues generated from certifying its buildings managed, developed, constructed, and/or designed according to independently developed energy performance ratings or labels?
P-03e22f1810e56fd1.zh: 公司是否追踪其管理、开发、建造和/或设计的建筑中，依据独立制定的能源绩效评级或标签获得认证的建筑所产生的可持续收入？

P-164e000c9ab99bc3.en: Does the company certify its buildings managed, developed, constructed, and/or designed according to independently developed sustainable building standards?
P-164e000c9ab99bc3.zh: 公司是否依据独立制定的可持续建筑标准，对其管理、开发、建造和/或设计的建筑进行认证？

P-da160aa23a3f6fb8.en: Does the company have a policy on the use of sustainable raw materials and is it available publicly?
P-da160aa23a3f6fb8.zh: 公司是否制定原材料可持续使用政策，并可公开查阅？

P-2af8800b594a34be.en: Does the company currently invest in thermal coal? If so, does it have a publicly available policy in place to restrict and/or exclude coal investments?
P-2af8800b594a34be.zh: 公司目前是否投资于动力煤？如果是，公司是否制定了公开可查的政策，以限制和/或排除煤炭投资？

P-0bce7926f4112106.en: Has the company been subject to inspection by regulators and/or received any FDA Form 483 notices or FDA Warning Letters (or equivalent notices from other agencies) as a result of production plant inspections by regulatory authorities in the last four years?
P-0bce7926f4112106.zh: 过去四年中，公司是否曾接受监管机构检查，和/或因监管机构检查生产工厂而收到任何 FDA Form 483 通知或 FDA 警告信（或其他机构的同等通知）？

P-c375b67debbaa505.en: Does the company have programs to manage its Acid Rock Drainage (ARD)?
P-c375b67debbaa505.zh: 公司是否有管理酸性岩石排水（ARD）的计划？

P-2311338f807c17fb.en: Does the company track its direct sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) emissions?
P-2311338f807c17fb.zh: 公司是否追踪其直接六氟化硫（SF6）排放？

P-769a5c671c2a7f59.en: Does the company track the average reliability of the company's electricity transmission and distribution systems?
P-769a5c671c2a7f59.zh: 公司是否追踪其输配电系统的平均供电可靠性？

P-485c113630463203.en: Does the company have a policy on animal welfare and is it available publicly?
P-485c113630463203.zh: 公司是否制定动物福利政策，并可公开查阅？

P-8f6c08f027d35a43.en: Does the company have programs on social integration?
P-8f6c08f027d35a43.zh: 公司是否有社会融合计划？

P-e41a2da7ca289668.en: Does the company track the revenues generated by transport modes that are owned, leased, and subcontracted, as well as the percentage of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions relative to its total fleet emissions for the last financial year?
P-e41a2da7ca289668.zh: 公司是否跟踪其自有、租赁和分包运输方式产生的收入，以及上一财年温室气体（GHG）排放占其车队排放总量的比例？

P-94e23d59bc6cd2c4.en: Does the company have programs on employing local people for at least 80% of its owned or operating sites?
P-94e23d59bc6cd2c4.zh: 公司是否在其至少80%的自有或运营场址开展雇用当地人员的计划？

P-ab66c717c5ede5f4.en: Does the company track the percentage of total products and impacts covered by the following life cycle assessment?
P-ab66c717c5ede5f4.zh: 公司是否追踪以下生命周期评估所覆盖的产品占全部产品的比例，以及所覆盖影响的比例？

P-5b2d6725c6c24f4b.en: Does the company have a policy outlining how it integrates sustainability into its financing activities and is it available publicly?
P-5b2d6725c6c24f4b.zh: 公司是否制定政策，说明其如何将可持续性纳入融资活动，并可公开查阅？

P-b0a2e4c0fead81f4.en: Does the company report on its sustainable fixed income underwriting or securitization issuance products and/or services for the last financial year?
P-b0a2e4c0fead81f4.zh: 公司是否报告上一财年可持续固定收益承销或证券化发行产品和/或服务？

P-640f0b71d3d558e7.en: Does the company currently finance the below-mentioned unconventional oil & gas fuels? If so, does it have a publicly available policy in place to restrict and/or exclude unconventional oil & gas financing?
P-640f0b71d3d558e7.zh: 公司目前是否为下述非常规油气燃料提供融资？如果是，公司是否已制定公开政策，以限制和/或排除非常规油气融资？

P-19a8f3a3389ac213.en: Does the company track its direct chemical oxygen demand?
P-19a8f3a3389ac213.zh: 公司是否追踪其直接化学需氧量？

P-7d2d2882bcc9da3f.en: Does the company have programs on water efficiency in construction?
P-7d2d2882bcc9da3f.zh: 公司是否有施工过程中的用水效率计划？

Question Rationale
All Poor occupational health and safety (OHS) performance directly
affects labor costs through lower productivity. Lower performance
not only poses a threat to a company’s reputation and staff morale it
results in increased operating costs in the form of fines and other
contingent liabilities. This question, aims to find out how a company
ensures effective management of health risks/issues and to identify
companies that have dedicated OHS programs.
The OHS programs should cover a set of actions that ensure a robust,
credible and reliable OHS management system, which aims to provide
tools to assess and improve performance in the prevention of
workplace incidents and accidents via the effective management of
hazards and risks.
